description: This file implements a Zoho Calendar service class with methods for authentication, event creation, updating, deletion, and calendar listing, integrating with Zoho's API and handling calendar events and availability data.

classes.name: ZohoCalendarService
classes.description: A class implementing the Calendar interface to interact with Zoho Calendar API, providing methods for authentication, event management, and calendar listing.

methods.name: zohoAuth
methods.description: Initializes authentication, manages token refresh, and provides token retrieval.

methods.name: fetcher
methods.description: Performs authenticated fetch requests to Zoho API endpoints.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Fetches user information from Zoho API.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event in Zoho Calendar.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event in Zoho Calendar.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event from Zoho Calendar.

methods.name: parseDateTime
methods.description: Parses date-time strings into dayjs objects.

methods.name: getBusyData
methods.description: Retrieves busy time slots for a user within a date range.

methods.name: getUnavailability
methods.description: Gets unavailability periods from calendar events within a range.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Calculates availability based on busy and unavailability data.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Lists Zoho calendars accessible by the user.

methods.name: handleData
methods.description: Handles API response data, throws on error.

methods.name: translateEvent
methods.description: Converts internal event format to Zoho API event format.
